title: Metric contracts and calibration harness for mixed-precision quant validation
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Implement a reusable metrics contract and calibration harness to validate FP8/INT8 quant profiles against accuracy baselines. Scope includes: (1) metric implementations (perplexity for language-modeling, MMLU-style aggregated accuracy for multi-task QA, ROUGE/BLANC/ROUGE-L and BLEU for summarization/translation, and task-specific scorers such as EM/F1 and token-level overlap for retrieval/reranking), (2) integration with activation/representative input collection during calibration runs, (3) gating rules to drive automated rollouts when quality deltas exceed thresholds, and (4) exporting structured metric results to the eval dashboard and the CI gating system.
acceptance_criteria: Perplexity computed end-to-end matches reference (within 0.5% on PTB/ WikiText sample) for FP32 baseline and produces comparable delta for quantized variants
MMLU-style suite: aggregated accuracy and per-subject breakdown available; run script yields reproducible scores and stores per-question predictions
ROUGE/BLEU: implement tokenization and reference handling consistent with existing eval infra; scores for summarization testcases show expected degradation patterns
Task-specific scorers (EM/F1): pass unit tests with edge cases (tokenization mismatches, multiple references) and match legacy scorer outputs
Calibration harness: representative activation capture (per-layer per-channel ranges, histograms) and bias-correction hooks are implemented and consumed by quant runner
Metric contract: each metric returns a stable serialized tuple (value, sample_count, 95pct_confidence_interval) as strings; CI can parse and gate on numeric thresholds
Dashboard integration: results for each quant profile and model are exported to eval pipeline and visible in the quant-evals Grafana panel
Automation: PRs that change quant/code paths trigger a lightweight eval (subset of MMLU + perplexity) in CI and fail if configured thresholds are exceeded
test_plan: Run the calibration + eval pipeline on two representative models (redwood-small-3B, open-llm-13B) across three quant profiles: fp8-compact, int8-perchannel, int8-legacy. For each run collect: raw logits, token-level alignments, per-layer activation histograms. Validate metric outputs against stored baselines and smoke-test dashboard ingestion. Add unit tests for metric edge-cases and a GitHub Actions job that runs the lightweight eval on PRs touching quant or metrics directories.

notes: Design decisions: (a) metrics expose a stable string-serializable contract so downstream CI and Console ingestion can parse without changing schemas; (b) use dataset-agnostic metric interfaces where a metric implementation plugs into the eval runner; (c) enable both batched and streaming eval modes — streaming returns incremental score updates for long-form generation; (d) support both absolute thresholds and relative delta thresholds (e.g., +2% perplexity or -0.5 absolute ROUGE-L) per-release.
